item.title: Costco Sued Over Claims Its Chicken Contains No Preservatives — What Are the Risks?
item.description: Costco is the subject of a proposed class action lawsuit following the assertion that its claims of "no preservatives" are false. Here's what we know.

item.title: President Donald Trump Announces Intent To Drive Housing Prices Up
item.description: At a January Cabinet meeting, President Donald Trump announced that he intends to increase the price of houses — not drive those prices down.

item.title: Punxsutawney Phil May Be the Most Famous, but He’s Not the Only Groundhog
item.description: How many groundhogs are there for Groundhog Day? While we may all watch Phil in Pennsylvania, he's not the only one making weather predictions.

item.title: International Traveler With Measles Visited Disneyland — Is an Outbreak Next?
item.description: According to the California Department of Public Health, an international traveler with the measles visited multiple locations, including Disneyland.

item.title: Florida’s Weather Now Includes Falling Iguanas, but What Makes the Reptiles Freeze?
item.description: Why do iguanas freeze? The reptiles have been seen falling from trees as temperatures drop in regions where they live, creating dangerous conditions.

item.title: NASA Announces the Anticipated Artemis II Moon Mission Has Been Delayed
item.description: Following the Artemis II wet rehearsal gone awry, NASA Administrator Jared Isaacman announced the launch window has been extended into March.

item.title: A USPS Driver Is Fighting for His Job After Posting About Being Forced To Work in a Winter Storm
item.description: A USPS mail deliver driver is sharing the story about how he put his life on the line to drive during a winter storm, when there was no work to be done.

item.title: A Poacher Is Believed To Have Killed a Beloved Yellowstone Wolf
item.description: Yellowstone is grieving after a poacher is believed to have shot and killed a prominent wolf from the park's most famous pack on Christmas day.

item.title: Florida Nurse Erik Martindale Is No Longer Registered Following Anti-MAGA Facebook Post
item.description: Following a viral Facebook post in which Martindale claimed he wouldn't give anesthesia to Republicans undergoing surgery, his license was removed.

item.title: Celine Dion Shares a Rare Health Update About Her Condition
item.description: Celine Dion issued a rare health update about how she's managing her Stiff Person Syndrome, a neurological condition she has been facing since 2022.
